items.summary: The Greenwood County Coroner's Office said 67-year-old Christopher John Miller died Sunday, Oct 11, after a large tree collapsed onto his home at 6802 Highway 702 in Ninety Six, South Carolina, during the remnants of Hurricane Isaias. He was pronounced dead at 12:21 p.m. ET; cause blunt-force trauma, ruled accidental. That lifts the Isaias US death toll to 9 (6 Florida, 2 Alabama, 1 South Carolina). Image is a verified Getty photo of Isaias tree damage in Milton, FL, Oct 10 (representative, same storm).
items.title: Isaias storm toll reaches 9: man killed by fallen tree in South Carolina
